core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hadia corresponds to the Arabic form هدية (Arabic root ه د ي (h-d-y); هدية (hadiyya)). Its core sense is gift, grace, blessing. Hadia is a South Asian spelling of Arabic هدية (hadiyya) 'gift, present'. The source gloss 'guide, leader' belongs to the different word هادي (hādī, 'guide') and has been replaced with the gift sense, which is what هدية actually means. Same name as hadiyah, hadiah, hadiya, hadiyyah, hadya.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Hadia, hadia. Script forms are هدية, هدیه, ہدیہ, हदिया.

faq.q: Is Hadia a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
